title: deutsch
measurementinprogress: The server is briefly unreachable, likely a measurement is in progress. Retrying automatically...
errorpost: The settings could not be saved
deletereadingerror: The reading could not be deleted
leakdetected: Risk of leakage as no durations with zero flow detected in the last 24 hours.
highflowdetected: Unusually high, sustained water flow detected. Possible pipe burst -- please check.
developermodedescription: Always show the most recently taken photo on the dashboard and in the table, even if the reading detection failed.
meterreplacementdetected: Possible meter replacement detected: the reading dropped sharply and stayed stable there. If the meter was actually replaced, please confirm it in the settings.
meterreplacementdescription: If the water meter was physically replaced, its reading starts again from 0. Confirm the replacement here so the new, low reading is no longer discarded as a faulty measurement and consumption reports are correctly split at this point in time.
meterreplacementconfirmerror: The meter replacement could not be confirmed
measurementcrashed: Measurement aborted (e.g. by a system restart)
deletenotificationsdescription: Permanently deletes all stored notifications (leakage, high flow, meter replacement, ...) from the database.
deletenotificationserror: The notifications could not be deleted
aboutsubtitle: Analog water meter reading with a Raspberry Pi and YOLO
aboutdescription: Turns a photo of an ordinary analog water meter into a continuous digital reading -- no smart meter, no retrofit. A camera and two YOLO models read the digit wheels and sweep needles, filter the result for outliers, and watch for leaks.
